camel_example: aliyun yike GetVideoDetextJob --region cn-hangzhou --JobId vdt_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef --version 2026-07-07 --method POST --force
description_en: Queries the status, input parameters, and video results of a video text removal job
description_zh: 查询视频文字擦除任务的状态、输入参数和视频结果
name: GetVideoDetextJob

parameters.help_en: The ID of the video text removal job returned by SubmitVideoDetextJob
parameters.help_zh: SubmitVideoDetextJob 返回的视频文字擦除任务 ID
parameters.name: job_id

ErrorCode.description_en: The business error code returned when the job fails. This field is typically not returned when the job is not in a failed state
ErrorCode.description_zh: 任务失败时返回的业务错误码；非失败状态通常不返回

ErrorMessage.description_en: The business error message returned when the job fails. This field is typically not returned when the job is not in a failed state
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 任务失败时返回的业务错误信息；非失败状态通常不返回

Input.description_en: The normalized JSON string of the input configuration saved during submission
Input.description_zh: 提交时归一化保存的输入配置 JSON 字符串
Input.title_en: 输入配置 JSON 字符串
Input.title_zh: 输入配置 JSON 字符串

JobId.description_en: The ID of the video text removal job
JobId.description_zh: 视频文字擦除任务 ID
JobId.title_en: 视频字幕擦除任务 ID
JobId.title_zh: 视频字幕擦除任务 ID

JobParameters.description_en: The normalized JSON string of the text removal parameters
JobParameters.description_zh: 归一化后的文字擦除参数 JSON 字符串
JobParameters.title_en: 任务参数 JSON 字符串
JobParameters.title_zh: 任务参数 JSON 字符串

JobType.description_en: The job type. The value is fixed as VIDEO_DETEXT

Output.description_en: The JSON character string of the task result. When Status is Finished, deserialize the sequence of this field and read AiResult.DetextVideoURL to obtain the URL of the video with text removed. If the node is not successfully completed, the video URL is not guaranteed to be included. If Output.OssUri is specified during commit, the result is stored in the specified OSS bucket. Otherwise, a signed URL is returned
Output.description_zh: 任务结果 JSON 字符串。Status 为 Finished 时，将该字段反序列化后读取 AiResult.DetextVideoURL，取得擦除后的视频地址；任务未成功完成时不保证包含视频地址。提交时指定 Output.OssUri 则结果位于指定 OSS，否则返回签名 URL
Output.title_en: 任务输出 JSON 字符串
Output.title_zh: 任务输出 JSON 字符串

Status.description_en: The job status. Valid values: Created, Queuing, Executing, Finished, and Failed

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used for Tracing Analysis and troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于链路追踪和问题排查
